wave: IND-6a (India acquisition - group A: TCS, HCLTech, ITC, Asian Paints)
policy: All files listed are real, unmodified documents exactly as served by the cited official source (exchange archive or company IR site). Nothing was invented, rounded, or synthesized. No anti-bot protection was bypassed: files were fetched through a normal interactive browser session (no captchas solved, no credentials, no cookie forging, no aggregator scraping; SPEC 2.4.6). Every exchange XBRL and every PDF listed was (re)fetched by this milestone through the browser on 2026-09-11 and verified byte-exact by sha256 after transfer. Files found already in storage from an earlier same-day session were re-fetched and confirmed identical before being accepted.

fetch_methods_used.browser: real Chromium session (Playwright); same-origin page-context fetch inside the served document/origin, base64 transfer, sha256 verified after decode. NSE integrated-filing JSON API called from the www.nseindia.com page's own session.

fetch_session.rate_limiting: single-shot low-volume fetches spaced >= 4-5 s apart per host; no throttling responses or rate-limit headers encountered. A parallel acquisition agent shared the browser intermittently; a tab was navigated away mid-fetch once (recovered by re-navigating; no data corruption - the failed cross-origin fetch returned a fetch error and was retried after re-navigation).
fetch_session.taxonomy_note: Per-instance taxonomy versions observed: all four Q1 FY27 consolidated instances carry 'IFIndAs V2.1 (26-06-2026)'; the April/May-filed Q4+FY26 consolidated originals carry 'IFIndAs V2.0 (06-02-2026)'; the Asian Paints Q4 consolidated REVISION (re-filed 15-Jul-2026) carries V2.1 - i.e. the taxonomy version varies per instance AND within one issuer-period across an original/revision pair. Namespace http://www.sebi.gov.in/xbrl/2026-01-31/in-capmkt, schemaRef in-capmkt-ent-2026-01-31.xsd (relative; schema not bundled).
